approved_balance_constraints.source: user gameplay guidelines, superseding concept-sheet evolution levels

approved_growth_transition.proposed_policy: At an evolution changing growth groups, convert stored experience to preserve current level and fractional progress toward next level. Handle delayed evolution and level 100; do not convert again for Slow-to-Slow evolution.
approved_growth_transition.reason: Growth tables store cumulative thresholds; changing species expRate alone leaves stored experience on the old scale.

approved_acquisition_policy.current_intended_access: User may create a separate patch to obtain all three base species for a playthrough. No acquisition patch requested yet.
approved_acquisition_policy.future_possibility: NPC gifts in a broader release; deferred, not authorized for implementation.
approved_acquisition_policy.scope_note: No normal acquisition source for any family. Existing approved breeding and evolution remain valid once specimens are externally obtained; this is not a breeding/evolution prohibition.

approved_other_defaults.regional_dex: No Johto regional Dex slots; preserve existing order.
approved_other_defaults.national_dex: Use approved internal IDs 1076-1086 as National Dex numbers, subject to engine integration checks.
approved_other_defaults.evolution_item_consumption: Neither Icicle Plate nor NeverMeltIce is consumed.

pokedex.entry_text: They brush against one another to build up electricity. Together, they create dazzling showers of sparks that frighten off much larger Pokémon.
Troop members practice together until their movements match perfectly. Their synchronized strikes overwhelm foes with powerful electric shocks.
The thunder of its four fists can be heard beyond the mountains. Villagers once believed that storms began wherever these Pokémon gathered to train.
Its will to live is remarkably strong. As its body begins to freeze, it draws its flame deep inside to keep it burning.
pokedex.dimension_source: Inferred design values; artwork has no calibrated scale

pokedex.entry_text: It basks on warm rocks along the slopes of volcanoes. As it matures, it makes its home ever closer to the crater.

pokedex.entry_text: Volcanic eruptions were once believed to be the result of two Magmalisk fighting over territory deep beneath the mountain. Its every step leaves a pool of bubbling lava behind.

pokedex.entry_text: Only an Embernewt whose flame survives being sealed in ice becomes this Pokémon. It draws all warmth from the surrounding air to keep its inner flame alive.
pokedex.dimension_source: Inferred design values; artwork has no calibrated scale

pokedex.entry_text: Travelers once froze solid following its glowing eyes through blizzards, believing them to be a distant hearth. Where it rests, winter lingers long after the surrounding snow has melted.
pokedex.dimension_source: Inferred design values; artwork has no calibrated scale

pokedex.entry_text: It loves to nap in shallow puddles. Its down soaks up so much water that it sometimes wakes to find itself sitting on dry ground.
pokedex.dimension_source: Inferred design values; artwork has no calibrated scale

pokedex.entry_text: It soaks its stone-like feathers in rivers before long flights. The absorbed water binds their layers together, repairing cracks caused by wear.
pokedex.dimension_source: Inferred design values; artwork has no calibrated scale

pokedex.entry_text: Ancient accounts describe a four-winged shadow followed by a rain of falling stars. Buried settlements have been found beneath the paths of its migrations.
